sourceFindings.defaultContentLength: The built-in response-header-content-length column uses response headers. The Size cell includes response transfer data.
sourceFindings.requestLength: The pinned implementation supports separate custom Request Headers columns. A request Content-Length column is possible in this version. Source support alone does not measure any request.
sourceFindings.connectionID: The connection ID identifies a network connection. It cannot substitute for the original requestId, frameId or targetId.
sourceFindings.fetchStages: The documented stages occur before the request is sent or after a response is available. Neither stage on its own measures a nonzero outgoing prefix.
sourceFindings.monitor: The vendor instructions describe an experiment and a recording view. There is no target, website request or cookie exposure claim from this source audit.
